mainEntity.name: How does AI SEO differ from traditional SEO for local home service providers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO relies heavily on manual research, keyword targeting, and periodic adjustments. AI SEO, however, automates many of these processes by using machine learning to continuously adapt to algorithm changes and evolving search behaviors. For local home service providers, this means more precise targeting of customers in specific geographic areas and dynamic content optimization based on real-time data, often resulting in quicker and more sustained improvements in local search rankings compared to manual approaches.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO automates and adapts to search changes using machine learning, offering more precise local targeting and dynamic optimization compared to manual traditional SEO.
